overview_description.description: Credibook is a startup helping retail wholesalers to keep track of receivables and payables. The startup digitizes the supply chain between wholesale and retail for more efficient inventory sourcing. It provides a variety of products and services that enable business owners to manage their businesses using digital technology, from order management to financial records. They intend to expand throughout Indonesia and reach out to more business sectors.
